   25 #===============================================================================
   26 # Hits in 2 volleys. The second volley targets the original target's ally if it
   27 # has one (that can be targeted), or the original target if not. A battler
   28 # cannot be targeted if it is is immune to or protected from this move somehow,
   29 # or if this move will miss it. (Dragon Darts)
   30 # NOTE: This move sometimes shows a different failure message compared to the
   31 #       official games. This is because of the order in which failure checks are
   32 #       done (all checks for each target in turn, versus all targets for each
   33 #       check in turn). This is considered unimportant, and since correcting it
   34 #       would involve extensive code rewrites, it is being ignored.
   35 #===============================================================================
   36 class Battle::Move::HitTwoTimesTargetThenTargetAlly < Battle::Move
   37   def pbNumHits(user, targets); return 1;    end
   38   def pbRepeatHit?;             return true; end
   39 
   40   def pbModifyTargets(targets, user)
   41     return if targets.length != 1
   42     choices = []
   43     targets[0].allAllies.each { |b| user.pbAddTarget(choices, user, b, self) }
   44     return if choices.length == 0
   45     idxChoice = (choices.length > 1) ? @battle.pbRandom(choices.length) : 0
   46     user.pbAddTarget(targets, user, choices[idxChoice], self, !pbTarget(user).can_choose_distant_target?)
   47   end
   48 
   49   def pbShowFailMessages?(targets)
   50     if targets.length > 1
   51       valid_targets = targets.select { |b| !b.fainted? && !b.damageState.unaffected }
   52       return valid_targets.length <= 1
   53     end
   54     return super
   55   end
   56 
   57   def pbDesignateTargetsForHit(targets, hitNum)
   58     valid_targets = []
   59     targets.each { |b| valid_targets.push(b) if !b.damageState.unaffected }
   60     return [valid_targets[1]] if valid_targets[1] && hitNum == 1
   61     return [valid_targets[0]]
   62   end
   63 end

  149 #===============================================================================
  150 # Hits X times, where X is the number of non-user unfainted status-free Pokémon
  151 # in the user's party (not including partner trainers). Fails if X is 0.
  152 # Base power of each hit depends on the base Attack stat for the species of that
  153 # hit's participant. (Beat Up)
  154 #===============================================================================
  155 class Battle::Move::HitOncePerUserTeamMember < Battle::Move
  156   def multiHitMove?; return true; end
  157 
  158   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  159     @beatUpList = []
  160     @battle.eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(user.index) do |pkmn, i|
  161       next if !pkmn.able? || pkmn.status != :NONE
  162       @beatUpList.push(i)
  163     end
  164     if @beatUpList.length == 0
  165       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  166       return true
  167     end
  168     return false
  169   end
  170 
  171   def pbNumHits(user, targets)
  172     return @beatUpList.length
  173   end
  174 
  175   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  176     i = @beatUpList.shift   # First element in array, and removes it from array
  177     atk = @battle.pbParty(user.index)[i].baseStats[:ATTACK]
  178     return 5 + (atk / 10)
  179   end
  180 end

  275 #===============================================================================
  276 # Two turn attack. Skips first turn, and increases the user's Special Attack,
  277 # Special Defense and Speed by 2 stages each in the second turn. (Geomancy)
  278 #===============================================================================
  279 class Battle::Move::TwoTurnAttackRaiseUserSpAtkSpDefSpd2 < Battle::Move::TwoTurnMove
  280   attr_reader :statUp
  281 
  282   def initialize(battle, move)
  283     super
  284     @statUp = [:SPECIAL_ATTACK, 2, :SPECIAL_DEFENSE, 2, :SPEED, 2]
  285   end
  286 
  287   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  288     return false if user.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack]   # Charging turn
  289     failed = true
  290     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  291       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  292       failed = false
  293       break
  294     end
  295     if failed
  296       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s stats won't go any higher!", user.pbThis))
  297       return true
  298     end
  299     return false
  300   end
  301 
  302   def pbChargingTurnMessage(user, targets)
  303     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is absorbing power!", user.pbThis))
  304   end
  305 
  306   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  307     return if !@damagingTurn
  308     showAnim = true
  309     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  310       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  311       if user.pbRaiseStatStage(@statUp[i * 2], @statUp[(i * 2) + 1], user, showAnim)
  312         showAnim = false
  313       end
  314     end
  315   end
  316 end

  414 #===============================================================================
  415 # Two turn attack. Skips first turn, attacks second turn. (Sky Drop)
  416 # (Handled in Battler's pbSuccessCheckPerHit): Is semi-invulnerable during use.
  417 # Target is also semi-invulnerable during use, and can't take any action.
  418 # Doesn't damage airborne Pokémon (but still makes them unable to move during).
  419 #===============================================================================
  420 class Battle::Move::TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct < Battle::Move::TwoTurnMove
  421   def unusableInGravity?; return true; end
  422 
  423   def pbIsChargingTurn?(user)
  424     # NOTE: Sky Drop doesn't benefit from Power Herb, probably because it works
  425     #       differently (i.e. immobilises the target during use too).
  426     @powerHerb = false
  427     @chargingTurn = (user.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack].nil?)
  428     @damagingTurn = (!user.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack].nil?)
  429     return !@damagingTurn
  430   end
  431 
  432   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  433     if !target.opposes?(user)
  434       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  435       return true
  436     end
  437     if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0 && !ignoresSubstitute?(user)
  438       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  439       return true
  440     end
  441     if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 && target.pbWeight >= 2000   # 200.0kg
  442       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  443       return true
  444     end
  445     if target.semiInvulnerable? ||
  446        (target.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0 && @chargingTurn)
  447       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  448       return true
  449     end
  450     if target.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] != user.index && @damagingTurn
  451       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  452       return true
  453     end
  454     return false
  455   end
  456 
  457   def pbCalcTypeMod(movetype, user, target)

  459     return super
  460   end

  462   def pbChargingTurnMessage(user, targets)

  503 # NOTE: Bulbapedia claims that an uproar will wake up Pokémon even if they have
  504 #       Soundproof, and will not allow Pokémon to fall asleep even if they have
  505 #       Soundproof. I think this is an oversight, so I've let Soundproof Pokémon
  506 #       be unaffected by Uproar waking/non-sleeping effects.
  507 #===============================================================================
  508 class Battle::Move::MultiTurnAttackPreventSleeping < Battle::Move
  509   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  510     return if user.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] > 0
  511     user.effects[PBEffects::Uproar] = 3
  512     user.currentMove = @id
  513     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} caused an uproar!", user.pbThis))
  514     @battle.pbPriority(true).each do |b|
  515       next if b.fainted? || b.status != :SLEEP

  517       b.pbCureStatus

  541 #===============================================================================
  542 # User must use this move for 4 more rounds. Power doubles each round.
  543 # Power is also doubled if user has curled up. (Ice Ball, Rollout)
  544 #===============================================================================
  545 class Battle::Move::MultiTurnAttackPowersUpEachTurn < Battle::Move
  546   def pbNumHits(user, targets); return 1; end
  547 
  548   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  549     shift = (5 - user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout])   # 0-4, where 0 is most powerful
  550     shift = 0 if user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout] == 0   # For first turn
  551     shift += 1 if user.effects[PBEffects::DefenseCurl]
  552     baseDmg *= 2**shift
  553     return baseDmg
  554   end
  555 
  556   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  557     if !target.damageState.unaffected && user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout] == 0
  558       user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout] = 5
  559       user.currentMove = @id
  560     end
  561     user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout] -= 1 if user.effects[PBEffects::Rollout] > 0
  562   end
  563 end

  565 #===============================================================================
  566 # User bides its time this round and next round. The round after, deals 2x the
  567 # total direct damage it took while biding to the last battler that damaged it.
  568 # (Bide)
  569 #===============================================================================
  570 class Battle::Move::MultiTurnAttackBideThenReturnDoubleDamage < Battle::Move::FixedDamageMove
  571   def pbAddTarget(targets, user)
  572     return if user.effects[PBEffects::Bide] != 1   # Not the attack turn
  573     idxTarget = user.effects[PBEffects::BideTarget]
  574     t = (idxTarget >= 0) ? @battle.battlers[idxTarget] : nil
  575     if !user.pbAddTarget(targets, user, t, self, false)
  576       user.pbAddTargetRandomFoe(targets, user, self, false)
  577     end
